facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - pressure exposure at P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4103 and TT-4103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-4103 and TT-4103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 18 April 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on P-4103 and TT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
